hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); for p in 'rm -rf /' 'yc resource-manager cloud delete' 'yc resource-manager folder delete' 'yc vpc network delete' 'yc vpc subnet delete' 'yc iam service-account delete' 'docker system prune -a'; do printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qi "$p" && { echo "BLOCKED: $p" >&2; exit 2; }; done; exit 0
CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '(curl|wget).*\|.*(bash|sh)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: pipe to shell' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
